# GrokBot animation source

`grok-player.js` and `grok-recipes.json` are the browser animation player and
extracted animation recipes published at <https://grokbot.yin.wiki/>.

They are vendored only so `tools/bake_grokbot.py` can reproduce the firmware's
pre-rendered animation atlas. The files are third-party analysis/reimplementation
artifacts and are not authored by this project. See the source site for its
documentation and terms. The Grok Bot name and character design belong to their
respective owners.
